evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce PlaceReasoner-Bench, a fully open end-to-end benchmark built from open RTL designs, EDA tools, and technology libraries.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We present PlaceReasoner-Beta, a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a closed-loop reasoning problem rather than black-box optimization.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across the benchmark, PlaceReasoner-Beta achieves the best timing among DRC-clean methods on all square tasks, reducing post-route TNS by 61.2% at 1:1 and 53.0% at 2:1 relative to the classical baseline field.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It comprises 8 designs at two aspect ratios, yielding 16 tasks with fixed floorplans and I/O assignments, so methods differ only in macro positions and orientations and are evaluated using routed PPA and DRC rather than pre-route proxies.
